findings.statement: The card's 'full-package pass ... every declaration of the integrated package ... excluding only the two negative-control modules' covers 237 of the 456 modules in the released tree; 219 modules are outside the audited import closure (D7:128, D9:24, D12:20, D10:12, D11:9, D8:6, Longrun:9, drivers:4). Kernel-cleanliness of those 219 is not established by the card; an independent source scan finds no top-level axiom there other than the two documented negative controls.

Two modules in the same released package declare the same constant Poincare.D7.ConjugateHeat.ConjugateHeatData (D7/ConjugateHeat/Basic.lean:129 and D7/Monotonicity/ConjugateHeatCertificate.lean:140). No single Lean environment can import both; `lake build` does not catch it. The card's collision check covers only the 161 merged modules.

The headline 'named blockers I4 and U7 ... are discharged' over-scopes: the volume/IBP results live on an abstract OverlapAtlas (M : Type* [MeasurableSpace M], chart : Nat -> Vec d -> M, metric : Nat -> ChartMetric d) with a glued chart-measure sum, not on a mathlib Riemannian manifold; the D6 ledger U7 entry still reads open and the queue still carries [I4,U7] with compiled_only_until_independent_semantic_review.

Three section-5 'downstream checked use' cells name proof inputs or terminal results rather than consumers: halfSpaceAtlas_laplacianIntegralZero has no consumer and its cell names the upstream input laplacian_integral_eq_zero; halfSpaceAtlas_integrable_dirichlet does not call halfSpaceAtlas_weightedIBP_unconditional (probe value=false); the W_gauss* names do not consume the I4 bridge. Also PartialChartModelPOU.lean has 29 declarations while the card says 27 in one place.

The strict-parabolicity certificate is disconnected from the analytic object: RicciDeTurckPicardModel has no field tying S/duhamel to principalSymbol/strictParabolic; existsUnique_mildSolution_of_model is P.duhamel.existsUnique_mildSolution (PicardModel.lean:158-161) and strictParabolic has no consumer; of_metric takes S,F,u0,DuhamelSetup as inputs, so it produces a packaged model + symbol certificate, not a short-time solution.

MildClassicalOutput's fields are exactly the unpacked DeTurckShortTimeExistence (D7/ShortTime/Statements.lean:98); deTurckShortTimeExistence_of_classicalOutput is the repackaging (h : MildClassicalOutput P) : DeTurckShortTimeExistence P. The card row 'never the conclusion' is inaccurate for that adapter. U8 itself is correctly not claimed closed.
